row: Gina Hamilton has formed her practice, Joy of Healing, with the mission to re-educate the body to heal itself with zero to minimal pharmaceuticals and surgery. Gina is a Licensed Massage Therapist and Spiritual Healer for humans and animals. In 2005 she graduated from Carlson College of Massage Therapy, in 2008 she became a Certified Small Animal Therapist through companion animal touch therapies, and in 2021 she became certified in Equine and Canine Sports Massage Therapies through Equissage. Her practice is a holistic approach to health and wellness, combining herbalism, aromatherapy with essential oils, chakra balance, and massage for body, mind, and spirit. Spiritual healing includes Shamanic Healing, Soul Reading, Past Life Journey, Animal Totems & Guides, and Tarot & Oracle card readings.
